subject: Accepted: conditional 25 fps floor (applies when the ink-hidden run reaches ≥ 30 fps) + 0.7× ratio; the real-iPad 60/120 fps check stays authoritative
body: Rationale: CI WebKit software rendering can't reach 25 fps even with ink hidden on desktop/dpr-2, so an unconditional floor measures the runner, not the engine. Keep recording both numbers in the JSON. Also: CI now lets push runs on claude/naadi-shared finish (82d359e), so a complete 3-browser run will confirm the WebKit scroll stability.
